summary: EUDA Health Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with GO POSB Organoids and Shenzhen Innovation Immunotechnology to collaborate on developing and commercializing iPSC and NK-TCR cell therapies. No financial terms (price, stake, premium) are disclosed. The MOU is a preliminary, non-binding collaboration agreement, not a definitive acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation event. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics beyond the announcement. The filing is routine disclosure of a commercial partnership. What to watch: whether the MOU leads to definitive agreements or further material developments.
